title: Creating a Folder in Media Manager
text:
## Creating a Folder in Media Manager
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052779
Creating folders within the Media Manager keeps images organized by page or event. The process takes two steps.
1. Open My Content > Media Manager and click +New Folder .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12182910723/original/J2bJVNHPzNe8xVrHLzYOj4iBhMZU9a7cVQ.png?1785487410 | alt: ]
2. Enter a name in the Insert Folder Name field.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079480497/original/9VG6jwPhQk5PbmmLVU4ZrrSvAFLnZfJeAw.png?1593708543 | alt: ]
IMPORTANT: As a best practice, avoid spaces in folder or file names. Use dashes or underscores instead (for example, event-photos or event_photos ) to prevent broken paths.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12079480448/original/2Uq-xw95BOn0jb1rYHSs1HOoSKvMDCVm5A.png?1593708518 | alt: ]
The folder is created immediately.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134919698/original/MpHMcrOD56Ogk_Lvn3tbAJzBLttMl6eNRg.png?1700856312 | alt: ]
Uploading an image inside a folder follows the same process as uploading an image into the Media Manager.
